page.heading: Global Horizon Mapping
page.subtitle: Decrypt the celestial blueprint across terrestrial space. Discover locations where your planetary potential reaches its zenith.
page.emptyBody: Astrocartography uses your precise birth moment to map planetary power lines across the globe. Enter your details to begin your relocation journey.
page.tipBody: Click anywhere on the map to instantly see your relocated Ascendant, nearest planetary line, and life-area interpretation for that location.

map.noneInOrb: No line within 800 km; this place is fairly neutral.
map.transitHint: Today's planets drawn in your natal frame (cyclocartography), so lines move with the planets.
map.dashaFocusTitle: Show only your current Mahadasha and Antardasha lords

cities.intro: Cities scored by distance to your natal MC, IC, AS and DS lines (800 km orb) and paran latitude bands.
cities.empty: Activate planetary layers to discover your top resonance cities.
cities.introWeighted: Ranked through your chart: lines of yogakaraka and functional benefics count for you, difficult lords against, and current dasha lords count more.
cities.goldTeaser: Gold ranks cities through your chart, separating supportive places from intense ones, and shows when each switches on in your dashas.

parans.intro: Parans are latitudinal bands where two planetary lines cross — zones of intensified combined energy.
parans.empty: No power crossings found within the selected planetary layers.
parans.fallback: {p1} and {p2} energies intersect — a zone of powerful planetary synthesis.

pairs.Su-Mo: Vitality meets emotion — a place of integrated personal power and authentic self-expression.
pairs.Su-Ju: Power meets wisdom — exceptional for career growth, recognition, and spiritual expansion.
pairs.Su-Ve: Confidence meets beauty — highly creative, socially magnetic, ideal for arts and leadership.
pairs.Su-Ma: Drive meets visibility — intense ambition and physical vitality. Best for competitive goals.
pairs.Su-Sa: Discipline under the spotlight — hard-earned success and lasting achievement.
pairs.Mo-Ve: Emotions meet harmony — deeply nurturing, romantic, and artistically fertile.
pairs.Mo-Ju: Feelings meet abundance — emotional security and spiritual nourishment.
pairs.Mo-Ma: Emotion meets action — dynamic but intense; best channelled into creative work.
pairs.Ju-Ve: Abundance meets harmony — one of the most auspicious crossings for love and prosperity.
pairs.Ju-Me: Wisdom meets communication — outstanding for teaching, publishing, and strategic business.
pairs.Ma-Ju: Drive meets expansion — powerful for athletics, entrepreneurship, and competitive success.
pairs.Ve-Me: Charm meets intellect — gifted in diplomacy, writing, and aesthetic communication.
pairs.Sa-Ju: Structure meets growth — serious long-term ambitions with practical wisdom.
pairs.Sa-Me: Precision meets thought — analytical depth; excellent for research and engineering.
pairs.Ra-Ju: Transformation meets opportunity — unconventional paths to great success.

guide.empty: Activate planetary layers on the map to unlock relocation insights.

AS.label: Identity
AS.desc: How you appear and feel about yourself here.

guide.vedicNote: Lines are read the Vedic way: functional nature by lagna, dig bala on the angles, Parashari drishti, and Vimshottari timing. Astrocartography itself is a modern technique; no classical text maps lines on the globe.

compare.intro: Shortlist up to three places and see them side by side.
compare.introGold: Shortlist up to three places. Scores are read through your chart: supportive minus challenging, with dasha timing.
compare.empty: Add places here, or use "Add to compare" on the map or in Top Cities.

couple.intro: Add a second chart to overlay their lines (purple, dotted) and find places that work for both of you.
couple.name: Name
couple.error: Could not calculate that chart. Check the details and try again.
couple.empty: No reference city has a line for either of you. Add places in Compare.

stars.title: Nakshatra star parans
stars.intro: Where a graha meets the yogatara (junction star) of a nakshatra on the angles. Read them as the nakshatra's quality colouring that latitude.
